brief:
A four-year-old child and four women were among Palestinians injured in a series of attacks in the West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The assaults followed a religious edict issued by a prominent far-right rabbi that permitted the seizure of Palestinian olives.

The incidents mark an escalation in settler violence targeting Palestinian communities and their agricultural operations in occupied territory.
dek: Attacks follow a religious edict by a prominent far-right rabbi permitting the seizure of Palestinian olives.
title: Settlers wound child, four women in West Bank attacks
